Oath of Ash.name: Fogcinder Knight
Oath of Ash.text: When you hit with Divine Smite, the target is wreathed in smoky cinders for 1 minute. It takes 2d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns and cannot benefit from being heavily obscured. A Constitution save ends it.

Oath of Ash.name: Brimstone Ashbringer
Oath of Ash.text: As a bonus action, mark a creature you can see within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your fire damage against it ignores resistance, and when it drops to 0 hit points it bursts, dealing 3d8 fire damage within 10 feet. Twice per long rest.

Oath of Ash.name: Wildfire Crusader
Oath of Ash.text: When you deal fire damage, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, cinders leap to a different creature of your choice within 15 feet, dealing 2d8 fire damage. Embers cannot leap to the same creature twice per turn.

Oath of Ash.name: Drowned-Ember Warden
Oath of Ash.text: Your fire burns underwater and in magical darkness. Once per turn, when a creature you hit is below half its hit points, it takes an extra 3d8 fire damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

Oath of Ash.name: Heartcinder Justiciar
Oath of Ash.text: Your aura becomes a slow fire. Enemies that start their turn in your aura take 2d6 fire damage, and you and allies in the aura regain 1d6 hit points when an enemy in it dies. Hostile creatures cannot be invisible inside it.

Oath of Ash.name: Starfire Scorcher
Oath of Ash.text: As an action, call a line of starfire 300 feet long and 15 feet wide. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground burns for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

Oath of Ash.name: Hollow-Ash Exemplar
Oath of Ash.text: Creatures you reduce to 0 hit points crumble to grey ash and cannot be raised by anything short of a wish. Once per short rest, when you score a hit, the target takes an extra 4d10 fire damage that cannot be reduced.

Oath of Ash.name: Ember of the Unspoken
Oath of Ash.text: As a reaction when an enemy within 30 feet casts a spell, it makes a Wisdom save. On a failure the spell burns away and is lost, and the caster takes 5d8 fire damage. Three times per long rest.

Oath of Ash.name: First Flame Incarnate
Oath of Ash.text: Once per long rest, become the first fire for 1 minute. You are immune to fire, your attacks deal an extra 4d12 fire damage, and enemies ending their turn within 30 feet make a Constitution save or take 6d10 fire damage.

Oath of Conquest.name: Fogbanner Conqueror
Oath of Conquest.text: Creatures frightened by you treat the area within 30 feet of you as heavily obscured to their eyes and cannot see allies there. While frightened of you, a creature's speed is 0 and it takes 2d8 psychic damage when it ends its turn.

Oath of Conquest.name: Tyrant of Twin Thrones
Oath of Conquest.text: As a bonus action, issue a command to a frightened creature within 60 feet: drop, kneel, or flee. It obeys unless it succeeds on a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failure. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

Oath of Conquest.name: Iron Riot Warlord
Oath of Conquest.text: When an enemy within 30 feet rolls a d20, you may use your reaction to force it to reroll and take the lower result. If it then fails, it is frightened of you until the end of its next turn. Five times per long rest.

Oath of Conquest.name: Crushing-Depth Overlord
Oath of Conquest.text: Frightened creatures within your aura are pressed down: their speed is halved, they have disadvantage on Strength saves, and they take 3d8 bludgeoning damage each time they try to move. Your aura reaches 30 feet.

Oath of Conquest.name: Heartchain Sovereign
Oath of Conquest.text: When a creature frightened of you drops to 0 hit points, you may instead leave it at 1 hit point and charmed by you for 1 hour, obeying simple orders. It may repeat a Wisdom save every 10 minutes. Once per long rest.

Oath of Conquest.name: Starbanner Conqueror
Oath of Conquest.text: As an action, plant your banner. For 1 minute, all enemies within 120 feet make a Wisdom save or become frightened of you, and allies within the same area gain +1 AC and add 2d6 to their weapon damage. Once per long rest.

Oath of Conquest.name: Hollow Throne Exemplar
Oath of Conquest.text: Creatures frightened of you cannot take reactions or cast spells above 5th level. Once per turn, you may deal an extra 5d8 psychic damage to a frightened creature and extend its fear by 1 round.

Oath of Conquest.name: Unspoken Dominator
Oath of Conquest.text: As a bonus action, a creature within 60 feet that can perceive you makes a Wisdom save. On a failure, it forgets its allegiances for 1 round and attacks the creature you choose. Three times per long rest.

Oath of Conquest.name: First Conqueror Incarnate
Oath of Conquest.text: Once per long rest, every creature of your choice within 300 feet makes a Wisdom save or kneels, prone and frightened for 1 minute. While kneeling, they take 6d10 psychic damage at the end of each turn they defy you.

Oath of Devotion.name: Veilward Paragon
Oath of Devotion.text: Your aura sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius that pierces magical fog and illusions. Allies in it have advantage on saves against illusion and charm, and invisible creatures in it are outlined and visible.

Oath of Devotion.name: Saint of Twin Verdicts
Oath of Devotion.text: When you hit with Divine Smite, a choir of light rings out. Up to three allies within 30 feet regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your Charisma modifier. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

Oath of Devotion.name: Steadfast Riot Saint
Oath of Devotion.text: You and allies in your aura cannot be charmed, polymorphed, or forced to move against their will. Once per short rest, when an ally in your aura fails a save, you may let them reroll it.

Oath of Devotion.name: Lightwell Bulwark
Oath of Devotion.text: As an action, become a lamp of radiant hope for 1 minute. Hostile creatures entering or starting their turn within 30 feet take 4d8 radiant damage, and allies there have resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. Once per long rest.

Oath of Devotion.name: Heartvow Paragon
Oath of Devotion.text: When an ally within your aura would drop to 0 hit points, you may use your reaction to take the damage instead. If you do, you regain 5d10 hit points afterward. Three times per long rest.

Oath of Devotion.name: Starlit Holy Champion
Oath of Devotion.text: Once per long rest, raise a holy banner for 1 minute. You and allies within 60 feet gain +1 AC, advantage on all saves, and deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage with weapon attacks.

Oath of Devotion.name: Lone Vigil Exemplar
Oath of Devotion.text: While no ally can see you, you gain +2 AC and your Divine Smite deals maximum damage. Once per long rest, when you would die, you instead return to 1 hit point and become immune to all damage until your next turn.

Oath of Devotion.name: Keeper of Unspoken Vows
Oath of Devotion.text: As an action, restore a creature within 30 feet: end every curse, charm, fear, and disease on it, and it regains 8d10 hit points. Twice per long rest.

Oath of Devotion.name: First Devotion Incarnate
Oath of Devotion.text: Once per long rest, shine with the world's first radiance for 1 minute. Fiends and undead within 60 feet make a Charisma save or are banished to their home plane, and your smites deal an extra 6d10 radiant damage.

Oath of Eternity.name: Mistbound Undying
Oath of Eternity.text: When you drop to 0 hit points, you may become a translucent shade instead of falling unconscious. Until the end of your next turn you are invisible, resistant to all damage, and can act. Once per long rest.

Oath of Eternity.name: Deathless Templar
Oath of Eternity.text: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, roll a d20. On 10 or higher, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Each time this succeeds before a long rest, the DC rises by 5.

Oath of Eternity.name: Unending Riot Knight
Oath of Eternity.text: Once per turn, when you take damage, roll a d6. On a 6, the damage is undone and you regain hit points equal to half of it. Below half hit points, you gain 2d10 temporary hit points at the start of each turn.

Oath of Eternity.name: Pressure-Proof Bulwark
Oath of Eternity.text: You no longer need to breathe, eat, or sleep, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, cold, and necrotic damage. When you end your turn at 0 hit points, you regain 4d10 hit points.

Oath of Eternity.name: Everheart Justiciar
Oath of Eternity.text: Allies within your aura cannot be reduced below 1 hit point by a single hit while you are conscious. Each time this protects an ally, you take 3d8 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced.

Oath of Eternity.name: Ageless Starwarden
Oath of Eternity.text: As a reaction when an ally within 60 feet dies, you may halt their death for 1 minute: they stay at 0 hit points, conscious, and able to act. Healing in that minute returns them fully. Twice per long rest.

Oath of Eternity.name: Hollow-Time Exemplar
Oath of Eternity.text: Once per long rest, when you would die, you step outside time for 1 round, then return with half your hit points maximum restored and all conditions ended. Enemies within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or are stunned.

Oath of Eternity.name: Oathkeeper Who Remains
Oath of Eternity.text: You cannot be erased, banished, or have your existence altered against your will. When reduced to 0 hit points, you may keep fighting for 3 rounds before falling. Once per long rest.

Oath of Eternity.name: First Eternity Incarnate
Oath of Eternity.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and up to six allies within 60 feet cannot drop below 1 hit point, and each regains 4d10 hit points at the start of their turns.

Oath of Glory.name: Mistsung Hero
Oath of Glory.text: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, ghostly echoes of your deed spread. Allies within 30 feet gain 2d8 temporary hit points and advantage on their next attack roll before the end of their next turn.

Oath of Glory.name: Choir-Hailed Champion
Oath of Glory.text: As a bonus action, inspire allies within 30 feet for 1 minute. Each gains a 1d8 bonus die they can add to one attack roll or save per turn. Twice per long rest.

Oath of Glory.name: Riot-Feat Paragon
Oath of Glory.text: Once per short rest, after you roll a d20, you may declare it a natural 20. If used on an attack roll, the critical hit deals an extra 3d10 radiant damage.

Oath of Glory.name: Deep-Legend Bulwark
Oath of Glory.text: Your Strength and Dexterity saves cannot be lower than 15. When you succeed on a save against an effect, you and allies within 30 feet gain 3d8 temporary hit points.

Oath of Glory.name: Heartsong Exemplar
Oath of Glory.text: Each time you defeat a creature of challenge rating 10 or higher, you gain 1 glory point, up to 5. Spend a point to add 3d8 to any roll or to regain 4d10 hit points. Points reset on a long rest.

Oath of Glory.name: Starsung Lord-Champion
Oath of Glory.text: As an action, your legend lights the sky for 1 minute. Allies within 120 feet gain an extra 15 feet of speed, +1 AC, and an extra 2d8 radiant damage on their first hit each turn. Once per long rest.

Oath of Glory.name: Unsung Exemplar
Oath of Glory.text: While no ally can see you, your weapon attacks score critical hits on a 18-20. Once per turn, a critical hit deals an extra 4d10 radiant damage.

Oath of Glory.name: Remembered Hero
Oath of Glory.text: When an ally within 60 feet would die, you may recount their deeds as a reaction: they instead drop to 1 hit point and gain 6d10 temporary hit points. Twice per long rest.

Oath of Glory.name: First Legend Incarnate
Oath of Glory.text: Once per long rest, become a living myth for 1 minute. You make one extra attack each turn, gain advantage on all rolls, and creatures that see you make a Wisdom save or are frightened and awestruck.

Oath of Redemption.name: Fogmercy Pilgrim
Oath of Redemption.text: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks, shroud it in calming fog. It makes a Wisdom save or its attack misses and it cannot attack until the end of its next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: Absolver of Twin Verdicts
Oath of Redemption.text: When you take damage from a creature, you may reflect half of it back as radiant damage and impose a Charisma save. On a failure it is charmed by you for 1 minute. Twice per short rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: Calm Within Riot
Oath of Redemption.text: As an action, hostile creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or lose all desire to fight for 1 minute, ending if they or allies are damaged. Once per long rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: Deepmercy Bulwark
Oath of Redemption.text: You gain resistance to all damage from creatures you have not attacked in the past minute. Enemies who damage you take 2d10 radiant damage as their own wrath turns on them.

Oath of Redemption.name: Heartmend Justiciar
Oath of Redemption.text: As an action, touch a creature reduced below half its hit points. It makes a Charisma save. On a failure, it lays down its arms and becomes friendly to you for 24 hours. Once per long rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: Starward Peacemaker
Oath of Redemption.text: As an action, declare a truce in a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. Any creature that makes an attack there takes 5d8 radiant damage and must make a Wisdom save or be incapacitated until its next turn. Once per long rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: Quiet Mercy Exemplar
Oath of Redemption.text: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you may stabilize it and redeem it: it loses hostility toward you and your allies until it is harmed. Once per turn, your reflected damage ignores resistance.

Oath of Redemption.name: Absolver of the Unspoken
Oath of Redemption.text: As an action, erase a creature's grudge: a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or forgets its hostility, cancels its concentration, and cannot target you for 1 minute. Three times per long rest.

Oath of Redemption.name: First Mercy Incarnate
Oath of Redemption.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute no creature within 120 feet can deal damage unless it succeeds on a Charisma save at the start of its turn. Those who fail regain 4d10 hit points instead.

Oath of Silence.name: Hushveil Knight
Oath of Silence.text: You and creatures you choose within your aura make no sound and leave no tracks. When you hit a creature that has not yet acted in combat, deal an extra 3d8 psychic damage, and it cannot speak until your next turn.

Oath of Silence.name: Mute Templar
Oath of Silence.text: Your Divine Smite also silences: the target makes a Wisdom save or cannot cast spells with verbal components for 1 minute. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

Oath of Silence.name: Quiet Riot Crusader
Oath of Silence.text: When you move, you never provoke opportunity attacks. Once per turn, after hitting a creature, you may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see without making a sound.

Oath of Silence.name: Soundless Deepwarden
Oath of Silence.text: Your aura becomes a zone of silence that you control. Enemies inside cannot cast verbal spells and take 2d8 thunder damage when they try. Allies inside are unaffected.

Oath of Silence.name: Stillheart Justiciar
Oath of Silence.text: Creatures cannot detect you by sound or tremorsense. When you attack a creature that is unaware of you, you score a critical hit on a 17-20 and deal an extra 4d8 radiant damage.

Oath of Silence.name: Starhush Lord-Commander
Oath of Silence.text: As an action, smother sound in a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. No spell with verbal components works there, and you may teleport to any point within it as a bonus action. Once per long rest.

Oath of Silence.name: Voiceless Exemplar
Oath of Silence.text: You are immune to thunder damage and deafness. Once per short rest, when you hit, the target makes a Constitution save or is stunned until the end of its next turn and loses its voice for 1 hour.

Oath of Silence.name: Keeper of the Unsaid
Oath of Silence.text: Three times per long rest, make an attack that cannot be perceived. It cannot be reacted to, and on a hit it deals an extra 6d8 psychic damage and the target forgets you were ever there.

Oath of Silence.name: First Silence Incarnate
Oath of Silence.text: Once per long rest, the first silence descends within 300 feet for 1 minute. Enemies cannot speak, cast spells, or take reactions unless they succeed on a Wisdom save at the start of each turn.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Fogtrail Avenger
Oath of Vengeance.text: Your Vow of Enmity target cannot become hidden or invisible from you. You always know its direction and distance within 1 mile, and your first hit against it each turn deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Hellbound Avenger
Oath of Vengeance.text: When your sworn foe damages an ally, it accrues a debt. Your next hit against it deals an extra 3d10 necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to half of that extra damage.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Relentless Riot Avenger
Oath of Vengeance.text: Once per turn, when your sworn foe moves away from you, you can teleport to a space within 5 feet of it and make a weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Abyssal Avenger
Oath of Vengeance.text: When you hit your sworn foe, it makes a Strength save or is pulled 20 feet toward you and its speed becomes 0 until your next turn. While grappled by you, it takes 3d8 necrotic damage each turn.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Grudgeheart Justiciar
Oath of Vengeance.text: You may maintain Vow of Enmity on two creatures at once. When either sworn foe drops to 0 hit points, you regain a use of Channel Divinity and 4d10 hit points.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Starhunt Avenger
Oath of Vengeance.text: Your sworn foe cannot escape you by teleportation or plane shift. When it does, you may follow it to its destination as a reaction. Once per long rest, your next hit after following deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Hollow Grudge Exemplar
Oath of Vengeance.text: Your sworn foe has disadvantage on all saves against your spells and features. Once per short rest, a hit against it is automatically a critical hit.

Oath of Vengeance.name: Avenger of the Unspoken
Oath of Vengeance.text: As an action, name a wrong done to you. The creature responsible, if within 1 mile, is marked as your sworn foe and takes 5d10 psychic damage. Three times per long rest.

Oath of Vengeance.name: First Vengeance Incarnate
Oath of Vengeance.text: Once per long rest, declare final vengeance on a creature. For 1 minute, every hit against it deals an extra 5d12 radiant damage and it cannot regain hit points, end conditions, or leave your presence by any means.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Mistgrove Warden
Oath of the Ancients.text: Your aura fills with drifting leaves and soft fog. Allies within it are lightly obscured to enemies, and creatures hostile to you take 2d6 radiant damage when they enter the aura or start their turn there.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Evergreen Templar
Oath of the Ancients.text: When an ally within your aura is reduced to 0 hit points, flowers burst from their wound and they regain 4d8 hit points instead. Twice per long rest.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Wildgrowth Crusader
Oath of the Ancients.text: As an action, the ground within 60 feet erupts with thorny growth for 1 minute. It is difficult terrain for enemies, who take 3d8 piercing damage when they move into it. Once per short rest.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Deeproot Bulwark
Oath of the Ancients.text: You and allies in your aura cannot be moved or knocked prone. When an enemy inside the aura casts a spell, it makes a Constitution save or vines bind it, restraining it until the end of its next turn.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Heartwood Justiciar
Oath of the Ancients.text: You regain 3d8 hit points at the start of each of your turns while you have at least 1 hit point. Allies in your aura gain resistance to necrotic damage and cannot be charmed.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Starbloom Elder
Oath of the Ancients.text: Once per long rest, spread a field of light-flowers in a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. Allies in it regain 3d10 hit points at the start of their turns, and enemies take 3d10 radiant damage.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Silent Grove Exemplar
Oath of the Ancients.text: When you die, a seed remains. After 1 minute you regrow from it with half your hit points, unless the seed is destroyed. Once per week.

Oath of the Ancients.name: Elder of Forgotten Spring
Oath of the Ancients.text: As an action, restore something lost: a creature within 30 feet regains a lost limb, sense, or level of exhaustion, and regains 8d8 hit points. Three times per long rest.

Oath of the Ancients.name: First Bloom Incarnate
Oath of the Ancients.text: Once per long rest, become the world's first spring for 1 minute. Allies within 120 feet regain 5d10 hit points each turn, and undead and fiends there take 6d10 radiant damage each turn.

Oath of the Crown.name: Fogcrown Sentinel
Oath of the Crown.text: Allies within your aura can hear your commands even through magical silence or fog. Once per turn, an ally in your aura may use its reaction to make one weapon attack when you hit a creature.

Oath of the Crown.name: Magistrate of Twin Courts
Oath of the Crown.text: As a bonus action, declare a law for 1 minute such as no flight or no teleport. A creature that breaks it within 60 feet takes 4d8 radiant damage. Twice per long rest.

Oath of the Crown.name: Unbowed Riot Marshal
Oath of the Crown.text: Allies within your aura cannot be frightened or forced to move. Once per turn, when an ally in your aura takes damage, you may reduce it by 2d10.

Oath of the Crown.name: Deepcourt Bulwark
Oath of the Crown.text: As an action, become the realm's anchor for 1 minute. You cannot be moved, and allies within 30 feet gain +1 AC and resistance to damage from creatures outside the aura. Once per long rest.

Oath of the Crown.name: Heartcrown Justiciar
Oath of the Crown.text: Any ally in your aura who rolls a 1 on a d20 may reroll it. When you succeed on a save, allies in your aura may also treat their next failed save as a success.

Oath of the Crown.name: Starcrown Lord-Commander
Oath of the Crown.text: Once per long rest, call your sworn followers. Up to six allies anywhere on the same plane are teleported to you and gain 4d10 temporary hit points.

Oath of the Crown.name: Empty Throne Exemplar
Oath of the Crown.text: You and allies in your aura cannot be charmed or have their will controlled. Once per short rest, a creature that tries is stunned until the end of its next turn and takes 5d8 psychic damage.

Oath of the Crown.name: Keeper of the Unspoken Crown
Oath of the Crown.text: As a bonus action, command an ally within 60 feet: it takes an extra action on its next turn. Three times per long rest. The ally also gains 3d8 temporary hit points and advantage on its next attack roll.

Oath of the Crown.name: First Crown Incarnate
Oath of the Crown.text: Once per long rest, issue a decree that binds all creatures within 300 feet for 1 minute. A creature that breaks it makes a Charisma save or is paralyzed for 1 round and takes 6d10 radiant damage.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Veilwatch Sentinel
Oath of the Watchers.text: You and allies in your aura see through magical fog, illusions, and invisibility within 30 feet. Extraplanar creatures in your aura cannot become hidden and have disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Gatewarden Templar
Oath of the Watchers.text: When an extraplanar creature within 60 feet tries to teleport or plane shift, you may use your reaction to force a Charisma save. On a failure, the effect fails and it takes 4d8 radiant damage.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Rift-Holder Crusader
Oath of the Watchers.text: As an action, anchor the space within 60 feet for 1 minute. No creature can teleport into or out of it, and summoned creatures take 3d8 force damage at the start of each turn. Once per short rest.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Abyss-Gate Bulwark
Oath of the Watchers.text: Your aura repels outsiders. Aberrations, fiends, and elementals cannot willingly enter it without a Charisma save, and take 4d8 radiant damage on a failure. Your aura also reveals their true forms and disguises.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Heartwatch Justiciar
Oath of the Watchers.text: You cannot be surprised, and you and allies in your aura add your Charisma modifier to initiative. Once per round, when an extraplanar creature enters your aura, make an attack against it as a reaction.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Starwatch Lord-Commander
Oath of the Watchers.text: You sense any portal, planar breach, or summoning within 1 mile. Once per long rest, you can banish all summoned creatures within 120 feet unless they succeed on a Charisma save.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Void-Watch Exemplar
Oath of the Watchers.text: Creatures from the Void are visible to you at all times. Your weapon attacks against extraplanar creatures deal an extra 4d10 radiant damage and ignore their resistances.

Oath of the Watchers.name: Watcher of the Unspoken
Oath of the Watchers.text: As an action, find every hidden passage, portal, or rift within 300 feet and seal any of them shut for 24 hours. Twice per long rest.

Oath of the Watchers.name: First Watch Incarnate
Oath of the Watchers.text: Once per long rest, become the boundary between worlds for 1 minute. Extraplanar creatures within 300 feet make a Charisma save or are banished, and you are immune to their damage.

Oathbreaker.name: Fogsworn Betrayer
Oathbreaker.text: Your aura of hate is laced with fog. Enemies within it have disadvantage on Wisdom saves and cannot see more than 10 feet. Undead and fiends in it gain your Charisma modifier to damage.

Oathbreaker.name: Faithless Templar
Oathbreaker.text: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you may raise it as a zombie under your control for 1 hour. You may control up to three this way at once.

Oathbreaker.name: Riot-Oath Defiler
Oathbreaker.text: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet succeeds on a save, you may force it to reroll. If it fails, it takes 3d8 necrotic damage. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

Oathbreaker.name: Drowned Oath Tyrant
Oathbreaker.text: Creatures that start their turn within your aura make a Strength save or have their speed halved and take 3d8 necrotic damage as dark weight presses on them.

Oathbreaker.name: Rotten-Heart Despot
Oathbreaker.text: As an action, curse a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It cannot regain hit points and takes 4d8 necrotic damage at the start of each turn. It may make a Wisdom save at the end of each turn. Twice per long rest.

Oathbreaker.name: Starfall Betrayer
Oathbreaker.text: Once per long rest, raise a black banner for 1 minute. Undead and fiends within 120 feet obey your commands, and enemies within that range have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

Oathbreaker.name: Hollow Oath Exemplar
Oathbreaker.text: You are immune to necrotic damage and cannot be charmed or frightened. Once per short rest, your smite deals maximum damage and the target cannot be healed until your next turn.

Oathbreaker.name: Unspoken Defiler
Oathbreaker.text: As an action, break a creature's bond: a creature within 60 feet loses all magical protections and concentration, and makes a Charisma save or is frightened for 1 minute. Three times per long rest.

Oathbreaker.name: First Betrayal Incarnate
Oathbreaker.text: Once per long rest, become the first broken oath for 1 minute. Enemies within 120 feet make a Wisdom save or turn on their allies, and your attacks deal an extra 5d12 necrotic damage.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Fograt Turncloak
Oathbreaker Knight.text: When an ally of your target is within 5 feet of it, you deal an extra 3d6 necrotic damage. Once per turn, after hitting, you may become invisible until the start of your next turn.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Oathless Templar
Oathbreaker Knight.text: When you break a promise or deceive a creature, you gain 3d10 temporary hit points and your next attack deals an extra 3d8 necrotic damage. Twice per short rest.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Riot-Traitor Knight
Oathbreaker Knight.text: As a reaction when an ally within 30 feet is attacked, you may swap places with it. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save or its attack instead targets another creature you choose.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Deep-Betrayer Bulwark
Oathbreaker Knight.text: Creatures who trust you take 4d8 psychic damage when you attack them. Your first hit against a creature that has not seen you attack deals an extra 4d8 necrotic damage.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Rotheart Knight
Oathbreaker Knight.text: When you take damage, you may break a piece of your vow: gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn and deal 3d8 necrotic damage to the attacker. Three times per long rest.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Starbreak Turncoat
Oathbreaker Knight.text: Once per long rest, tear down an enemy banner: enemies within 120 feet lose all bonuses from auras, spells, and inspiration, and make a Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 minute.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Hollow-Oath Exemplar
Oathbreaker Knight.text: While you have no allies within 30 feet, you score critical hits on a 18-20 and deal an extra 4d10 necrotic damage on critical hits. You cannot be charmed.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: Unspoken Turncloak
Oathbreaker Knight.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or forgets an oath, vow, or promise it holds and becomes charmed by you for 1 minute. Three times per long rest.

Oathbreaker Knight.name: First Traitor Incarnate
Oathbreaker Knight.text: Once per long rest, become the first betrayal for 1 minute. Every creature within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or treats its allies as enemies, and you deal an extra 5d12 necrotic damage.

Beast Lord.name: Fogpack Lord
Beast Lord.text: Both of your bonded beasts can move through magical fog without penalty and become invisible while in dim light or fog. When both beasts hit the same target in one round, it takes an extra 2d8 damage.

Beast Lord.name: Hellhound Packmaster
Beast Lord.text: Your beasts' attacks count as magical and deal an extra 1d8 fire or radiant damage, your choice each turn. When one beast drops to 0 hit points, the other gains 3d10 temporary hit points.

Beast Lord.name: Riotpack Wayleader
Beast Lord.text: As a bonus action, swap the positions of your two beasts, or of you and one beast, if they are within 60 feet. A beast that swaps can immediately make one attack.

Beast Lord.name: Deep-Pack Overlord
Beast Lord.text: When both of your beasts are within 5 feet of a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and saves, and takes 3d8 piercing damage at the start of its turn.

Beast Lord.name: Elderpack Lord
Beast Lord.text: Your beasts gain your proficiency bonus to AC, max 2, and saves. Once per long rest, revive a fallen beast as a bonus action with full hit points.

Beast Lord.name: Starpack Outrider
Beast Lord.text: Once per long rest, call a third spirit beast for 1 minute. It uses your beast's statistics and its attacks deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage.

Beast Lord.name: Silent Pack Strider
Beast Lord.text: You and your beasts make no sound, leave no trace, and cannot be tracked. Attacks from your beasts against an unaware creature are critical hits.

Beast Lord.name: Forgotten Pack Lord
Beast Lord.text: As an action, your beasts vanish from all memory. For 1 minute, creatures cannot target them unless they succeed on a Wisdom save at the start of their turn. Twice per long rest.

Beast Lord.name: First Pack Incarnate
Beast Lord.text: Once per long rest, your beasts become primordial beasts for 1 minute. They grow to Huge size, make two attacks each turn, and deal an extra 4d12 damage.

Beast Master.name: Mistfang Companion
Beast Master.text: Your beast companion can see through fog and illusion. When it hits a creature, that creature cannot become hidden from you or your companion for 1 minute and takes an extra 2d6 damage.

Beast Master.name: Hellhound Warden
Beast Master.text: Your companion's attacks deal an extra 1d10 fire damage. When your companion takes damage, you may take half of it instead as a reaction. Your companion may also teleport 15 feet as part of its movement once per turn.

Beast Master.name: Shiftfur Wayfinder
Beast Master.text: As a bonus action, your companion may change its form to a beast of the same size, keeping its hit points. Once per turn, it may teleport 15 feet before or after an attack.

Beast Master.name: Deepfang Trapper
Beast Master.text: When your companion hits, the target makes a Strength save or is grappled and restrained. While grappled this way, it takes 3d8 piercing damage at the start of each turn.

Beast Master.name: Elderbond Huntmaster
Beast Master.text: You and your companion share hit points: when either would drop to 0, the other may give up to half its current hit points to save it. You both gain resistance to poison damage.

Beast Master.name: Starbeast Outrider
Beast Master.text: Your companion gains a flying speed of 60 feet and its attacks deal an extra 2d10 radiant damage. Once per long rest, it can carry you anywhere within 1 mile instantly.

Beast Master.name: Hollow-Bond Strider
Beast Master.text: Your companion becomes invisible while it does not attack. Its first attack each turn against a creature that cannot see it deals an extra 4d8 damage.

Beast Master.name: Forgotten Beastmaster
Beast Master.text: Your companion cannot be charmed, frightened, or controlled. Once per long rest, when it dies, it returns at full hit points on your next turn as if it never fell.

Beast Master.name: First Beast Incarnate
Beast Master.text: Once per long rest, your companion becomes a primordial beast for 1 minute. It grows to Gargantuan size, makes three attacks per turn, and deals an extra 5d12 damage.

Drakewarden.name: Fogscale Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Your drake can exhale a 30-foot cone of magical fog. Creatures in it make a Constitution save or take 4d8 damage of your drake's type and are blinded until the end of their next turn. Twice per short rest.

Drakewarden.name: Brimscale Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Your drake's bite deals an extra 2d8 fire or radiant damage. Once per long rest, it may grow to Large size for 1 minute and you may ride it.

Drakewarden.name: Chaos-Scale Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: When your drake uses its breath, choose any two damage types. The breath deals 6d8 damage of the chosen types, split evenly, in a 60-foot cone.

Drakewarden.name: Deepscale Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Your drake gains +1 AC and resistance to cold and bludgeoning damage. It can breathe underwater, and its bite pulls targets 10 feet closer on a hit.

Drakewarden.name: Elderdrake Warden
Drakewarden.text: When your drake hits, you regain 2d8 hit points. When you hit, your drake gains 2d8 temporary hit points. Both gain resistance to your drake's damage type.

Drakewarden.name: Starwing Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Your drake gains a flying speed of 90 feet and can carry you. Once per long rest, it can breathe starfire in a 120-foot line dealing 8d10 radiant damage on a failed Dexterity save, half on a success.

Drakewarden.name: Hollow-Scale Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Your drake makes no sound and is invisible while flying. Its bite deals an extra 4d8 damage against creatures that cannot see it. You may ride it while it flies, and you share its invisibility.

Drakewarden.name: Forgotten Drakewarden
Drakewarden.text: Once per long rest, your drake recalls its ancient lineage for 1 minute. It becomes Huge, gains 100 temporary hit points, and its breath recharges on 4-6.

Drakewarden.name: First Dragon Incarnate
Drakewarden.text: Once per long rest, your drake becomes a primordial dragon for 1 minute. It grows Gargantuan, makes three attacks per turn, and its breath deals 12d12 damage.

Fey Wanderer.name: Mistfey Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: When you hit a creature, you may teleport up to 30 feet to a space filled with fog or dim light. The target makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you until the end of its next turn.

Fey Wanderer.name: Twin Court Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: When a creature fails a save against your charm, it owes you a favour. You can call in the favour as a bonus action to make it attack one of its allies. Twice per long rest.

Fey Wanderer.name: Whimsy Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: As an action, choose a creature within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom save or rolls on a random effect: frightened, charmed, or confused for 1 minute, and takes 3d8 psychic damage.

Fey Wanderer.name: Deepfey Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: Creatures within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on saves against charm. When a creature charmed by you takes damage, it takes an extra 3d8 psychic damage.

Fey Wanderer.name: Heartfey Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: You may charm a creature for 24 hours with a touch, unless it succeeds on a Wisdom save. While charmed, it acts as your friend and ally. Once per long rest.

Fey Wanderer.name: Starfey Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: Once per long rest, you and up to six allies may step into the Fey Paths and appear anywhere within 10 miles. Creatures who see you make a Wisdom save or are charmed for 1 minute.

Fey Wanderer.name: Hollow Fey Strider
Fey Wanderer.text: Once per turn, after you hit a creature, it makes a Wisdom save or forgets you exist for 1 minute, unless you attack it again.

Fey Wanderer.name: Forgotten Fey Wanderer
Fey Wanderer.text: As an action, wipe a creature's memory of the last hour. It makes a Wisdom save or loses all knowledge of that time and is stunned until the end of its next turn. Three times per long rest.

Fey Wanderer.name: First Fey Incarnate
Fey Wanderer.text: Once per long rest, become the first fey for 1 minute. All creatures within 120 feet make a Wisdom save or are charmed by you, and you can teleport 60 feet as a bonus action each turn.

Gloom Stalker.name: Fogshade Stalker
Gloom Stalker.text: While in fog or dim light, you are invisible to creatures that rely on sight. Your first attack each turn against a creature that cannot see you deals an extra 2d8 damage.

Gloom Stalker.name: Brimdark Stalker
Gloom Stalker.text: On your first turn of combat, you take an extra action. Creatures you hit during that turn take an extra 3d8 necrotic damage and are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

Gloom Stalker.name: Shiftgloom Stalker
Gloom Stalker.text: As a bonus action, teleport from one area of dim light or darkness to another within 60 feet. When you appear, your next attack this turn has advantage.

Gloom Stalker.name: Pitchdeep Stalker
Gloom Stalker.text: You have truesight in darkness to 120 feet. Creatures in darkness have disadvantage on saves against your features, and your attacks deal an extra 3d8 necrotic damage to them.

Gloom Stalker.name: Gloomheart Huntmaster
Gloom Stalker.text: You gain resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. When you take damage in darkness, you may use your reaction to become invisible until the start of your next turn.

Gloom Stalker.name: Starless Outrider
Gloom Stalker.text: Once per long rest, call total darkness in a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. You see normally inside it, and your attacks there deal an extra 4d10 necrotic damage.

Gloom Stalker.name: Hollow-Gloom Strider
Gloom Stalker.text: You cannot be detected by divination, truesight, or blindsight unless you choose to be. Once per short rest, your first hit on an unaware creature deals maximum damage.

Gloom Stalker.name: Trackless Gloom
Gloom Stalker.text: Creatures that lose sight of you forget you were there and must spend an action to recall you. Your attacks against creatures that have forgotten you are critical hits.

Gloom Stalker.name: First Dark Incarnate
Gloom Stalker.text: Once per long rest, become the first darkness for 1 minute. Light cannot exist within 60 feet of you, and you make two extra attacks each turn that deal an extra 4d12 necrotic damage.

Horizon Walker.name: Fogline Planeswalker
Horizon Walker.text: As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 feet through fog or illusion. When you arrive, your next attack deals an extra 2d8 force damage. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Horizon Walker.name: Hell-Gate Warden
Horizon Walker.text: As an action, open a portal for 1 minute. Creatures who pass through take 4d8 fire or radiant damage, and you and allies may step through to any point within 120 feet. Once per short rest.

Horizon Walker.name: Shiftway Planewalker
Horizon Walker.text: When you teleport, choose one creature within 10 feet of your origin or destination. It makes a Charisma save or is teleported with you to a space adjacent to you.

Horizon Walker.name: Deepgate Walker
Horizon Walker.text: You can sense planar boundaries within 1 mile. Once per short rest, open a rift beneath a creature within 60 feet; it makes a Dexterity save or falls into the Abyss for 1 round and takes 6d8 cold damage.

Horizon Walker.name: Heartgate Walker
Horizon Walker.text: Your body becomes a gate. Allies within 30 feet may teleport to any space adjacent to you as a bonus action. Once per turn, you may teleport an ally within 60 feet to you.

Horizon Walker.name: Starfield Planestrider
Horizon Walker.text: Once per long rest, you and up to six allies may teleport to any point you have seen on the same plane, or to another plane you have visited.

Horizon Walker.name: Hollow Gate Strider
Horizon Walker.text: You can walk into the Void and return, becoming untargetable until the start of your next turn. While there, you can move up to 120 feet. Three times per long rest.

Horizon Walker.name: Unremembered Walker
Horizon Walker.text: As an action, banish a creature within 60 feet into a forgotten corner of the planes. It makes a Charisma save or vanishes for 1 minute, returning confused. Twice per long rest.

Horizon Walker.name: First Gate Incarnate
Horizon Walker.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can teleport anywhere on any plane as a bonus action, and your attacks banish targets on a failed Charisma save.

Hunter.name: Mistmark Hunter
Hunter.text: Your Hunter's Mark target cannot hide from you in fog, darkness, or illusion. Once per turn, you deal an extra 2d8 damage to a marked target that is lightly or heavily obscured.

Hunter.name: Hellhunt Warden
Hunter.text: Your attacks deal an extra 2d10 damage against fiends and celestials. When you kill one, you regain a use of a hunter's tactic and 2d10 hit points.

Hunter.name: Shiftwind Hunter
Hunter.text: At the start of each turn, choose one Hunter option from any tier. You gain that option until your next turn, in addition to your existing ones.

Hunter.name: Deeptrack Hunter
Hunter.text: As an action, set a snare. The next creature to enter a 10-foot square makes a Dexterity save or is restrained and takes 4d8 piercing damage. You may have up to three snares.

Hunter.name: Elderwood Hunter
Hunter.text: You gain advantage on Wisdom saves and cannot be surprised. Once per turn, when you miss with an attack, you may reroll it and must use the new roll.

Hunter.name: Starfall Hunter
Hunter.text: Once per short rest, as an action, make a ranged attack against every creature of your choice within 120 feet. Each hit deals an extra 2d10 radiant damage.

Hunter.name: Silent Hunter
Hunter.text: Your attacks make no sound. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you may immediately make one attack against another creature within range.

Hunter.name: Trackless Hunter
Hunter.text: Your marked target does not know it is hunted. It makes a Wisdom save at the start of its turn or is unable to move away from you, and takes 4d8 psychic damage.

Hunter.name: First Hunter Incarnate
Hunter.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you make two extra attacks each turn, and every hit forces a Constitution save or the target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

Monster Slayer.name: Mistbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: Your Slayer's Prey target cannot be invisible or disguised to you. When you hit it, it makes a Wisdom save or loses its resistances until the end of your next turn.

Monster Slayer.name: Demonbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: Your attacks against fiends, celestials, and undead deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage. They have disadvantage on saves against your features. When one dies within 30 feet, you regain 2d10 hit points.

Monster Slayer.name: Chaosbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: When your prey casts a spell, you may use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution save. On a failure, the spell is wasted and it takes 3d8 force damage.

Monster Slayer.name: Abyssbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: Against creatures from the Abyss or aberrations, your attacks score critical hits on 19-20 and deal an extra 4d8 damage. Their speed is halved until the end of their next turn after you hit them.

Monster Slayer.name: Elderbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: You may mark two Slayer's Prey targets at once. When one dies, you regain 3d10 hit points and gain advantage on your next attack against the other.

Monster Slayer.name: Starbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: Once per long rest, mark a creature of challenge rating 20 or higher. For 1 minute, your attacks against it deal an extra 5d10 damage and ignore resistances.

Monster Slayer.name: Voidbane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: You see creatures from the Void at all times. Your attacks against them deal an extra 5d8 force damage and they cannot teleport while within 60 feet of you.

Monster Slayer.name: Forgotten Bane Slayer
Monster Slayer.text: When you kill a monster, it cannot return by any means short of a wish. Once per long rest, you can make your prey forget its own abilities for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save.

Monster Slayer.name: First Slayer Incarnate
Monster Slayer.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute every hit you make against a monster forces a Constitution save or it takes an extra 8d12 damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

Moon Hunter.name: Fogmoon Hunter
Moon Hunter.text: While in dim light or fog, you see as if under bright moonlight. Your attacks against shapechangers deal an extra 2d8 silver radiant damage and force them back into their true form.

Moon Hunter.name: Hellmoon Hunt-Warden
Moon Hunter.text: Once per long rest, call a blood moon for 1 minute. Your attacks deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage, and shapechangers cannot change form. You and allies within 30 feet have advantage on saves against charm and fear under it.

Moon Hunter.name: Shiftmoon Hunter
Moon Hunter.text: At the start of each turn, roll a d4 to choose a moon phase: speed, stealth, damage, or healing. You gain a 3d8 bonus to that phase's rolls until your next turn.

Moon Hunter.name: Drowned Moon Trapper
Moon Hunter.text: You can breathe underwater and see in magical darkness. Your attacks against creatures in darkness deal an extra 3d8 cold damage. You also have advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight or smell while underwater or in darkness.

Moon Hunter.name: Heartmoon Huntmaster
Moon Hunter.text: As a bonus action, take on a wolfish form for 1 minute. You gain +1 AC, an extra 20 feet of speed, and your attacks deal an extra 2d8 damage. Twice per long rest.

Moon Hunter.name: Starmoon Outrider
Moon Hunter.text: Once per long rest, call a full moon over 1 mile for 1 hour. Shapechangers cannot change shape, and your attacks against them deal an extra 4d10 radiant damage.

Moon Hunter.name: New Moon Strider
Moon Hunter.text: While in darkness, you are invisible and silent. Your first hit each turn against a creature in darkness deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage. Against shapechangers, this extra damage is doubled.

Moon Hunter.name: Forgotten Moon Hunter
Moon Hunter.text: Once per long rest, call an eclipse for 1 minute. Creatures within 300 feet make a Wisdom save or forget their abilities and cannot use them until the eclipse ends.

Moon Hunter.name: First Moon Incarnate
Moon Hunter.text: Once per long rest, become the first moon for 1 minute. Shapechangers within 300 feet are paralyzed, and your attacks deal an extra 6d12 radiant damage.

Swarmkeeper.name: Mistswarm Keeper
Swarmkeeper.text: Your swarm can become a cloud of fog in a 20-foot radius around you. Creatures inside have disadvantage on attack rolls against you and take 2d6 piercing damage at the start of their turns.

Swarmkeeper.name: Hellswarm Warden
Swarmkeeper.text: Your swarm's damage becomes fire or radiant, your choice. When a creature takes swarm damage, it makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

Swarmkeeper.name: Riotswarm Keeper
Swarmkeeper.text: When your swarm moves a creature, you may move it up to 30 feet in any direction, including up. The creature takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage if it lands in an obstacle.

Swarmkeeper.name: Deepswarm Keeper
Swarmkeeper.text: Your swarm can grapple creatures. While grappled by the swarm, a creature is restrained and takes 3d8 piercing damage at the start of its turn.

Swarmkeeper.name: Heartswarm Keeper
Swarmkeeper.text: Your swarm grows into a horde. You may split it into two swarms that act independently, each dealing your swarm's damage. Once per long rest, revive a lost swarm.

Swarmkeeper.name: Starswarm Outrider
Swarmkeeper.text: Once per long rest, your swarm becomes a cloud of starlight 120 feet wide for 1 minute. Enemies inside take 4d10 radiant damage at the start of their turns.

Swarmkeeper.name: Hollow Swarm Strider
Swarmkeeper.text: Your swarm makes no sound and is invisible. Creatures inside your swarm's area cannot see you, and you may teleport anywhere within the swarm as a bonus action.

Swarmkeeper.name: Forgotten Swarm
Swarmkeeper.text: As an action, your swarm erases a creature's memories within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom save or forgets its last turn and loses its next reaction. Three times per long rest.

Swarmkeeper.name: First Swarm Incarnate
Swarmkeeper.text: Once per long rest, become the first swarm for 1 minute. You are immune to weapon damage, and creatures within 60 feet take 6d10 piercing damage at the start of their turns.

Thornwalker.name: Mistthorn Walker
Thornwalker.text: You can move through brambles and fog without penalty. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d8 piercing damage from thorns that sprout from your skin.

Thornwalker.name: Brimthorn Warden
Thornwalker.text: As an action, raise a wall of burning thorns 60 feet long and 10 feet high for 1 minute. Creatures who pass through take 4d8 fire damage. Once per short rest.

Thornwalker.name: Chaosthorn Walker
Thornwalker.text: When you take damage, thorns lash out at a random creature within 15 feet, dealing 3d8 piercing damage. You may choose to exclude allies from this effect.

Thornwalker.name: Deepthorn Trapper
Thornwalker.text: When you hit a creature, thorny roots bind it. It makes a Strength save or is restrained and takes 3d8 piercing damage at the start of its turn.

Thornwalker.name: Heartthorn Huntmaster
Thornwalker.text: You gain +1 AC and resistance to piercing and slashing damage. Creatures who grapple you take 4d8 piercing damage each turn. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it makes a Dexterity save or is restrained by briars until its next turn.

Thornwalker.name: Starthorn Outrider
Thornwalker.text: Once per long rest, cover 120 feet with thorns for 1 minute. It is difficult terrain for enemies, who take 4d10 piercing damage when they move into it.

Thornwalker.name: Hollowthorn Strider
Thornwalker.text: Thorns that grow from you are invisible. Creatures that touch you take 4d8 piercing damage and have their speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

Thornwalker.name: Forgotten Thornwalker
Thornwalker.text: When a creature takes thorn damage from you, it makes a Wisdom save or forgets its last action and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. A creature can be affected only once per round.

Thornwalker.name: First Thorn Incarnate
Thornwalker.text: Once per long rest, become the first thorn for 1 minute. Any creature that hits you takes 6d10 piercing damage, and you deal an extra 4d12 piercing damage.

Void Stalker.name: Fogvoid Stalker
Void Stalker.text: You can see invisible creatures and things from the Void within 60 feet. When you hit such a creature, it takes an extra 2d8 force damage and cannot become invisible until your next turn.

Void Stalker.name: Brimvoid Hunt-Warden
Void Stalker.text: Your attacks against creatures from the Void deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage. When you kill one, you gain 3d10 temporary hit points. They also cannot become invisible or ethereal for 1 minute after you hit them.

Void Stalker.name: Chaosvoid Stalker
Void Stalker.text: When you hit a Void creature, it makes a Charisma save or is pulled back into reality and cannot teleport or phase until the end of its next turn.

Void Stalker.name: Abyssvoid Trapper
Void Stalker.text: As an action, place a Void snare in a 10-foot square. The next creature to enter it makes a Dexterity save or is restrained and takes 4d8 force damage.

Void Stalker.name: Heartvoid Huntmaster
Void Stalker.text: You gain resistance to force and psychic damage. When a Void creature tries to harm you, it makes a Wisdom save or its attack fails.

Void Stalker.name: Starvoid Outrider
Void Stalker.text: Once per long rest, track a Void creature across any distance on the same plane for 24 hours. Your first hit against it deals an extra 6d10 force damage.

Void Stalker.name: Trueless Void-Strider
Void Stalker.text: You are invisible to creatures from the Void. Your attacks against them are critical hits on 18-20 and deal an extra 4d10 force damage. You also have advantage on saves against their abilities.

Void Stalker.name: Unremembered Stalker
Void Stalker.text: As an action, a Void creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or forgets its nature and becomes a mortal creature for 1 minute, losing all resistances and immunities. Twice per long rest.

Void Stalker.name: First Void-Hunter Incarnate
Void Stalker.text: Once per long rest, become the first hunter of nothing for 1 minute. All Void creatures within 300 feet are visible, and your attacks against them deal an extra 6d12 force damage.

Arcane Trickster.name: Fogglass Trickster
Arcane Trickster.text: As a bonus action, create an illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute. You may cast spells and make Sneak Attacks as if from its space. A creature that touches it sees through it. Twice per short rest.

Arcane Trickster.name: Brimstone Conjurer
Arcane Trickster.text: Your illusions can burn. Once per turn, a creature that interacts with one of your illusions makes an Intelligence save or takes 3d8 fire or psychic damage as if it were real.

Arcane Trickster.name: Loaded-Spell Grifter
Arcane Trickster.text: As a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, make an Intelligence check against DC 10 + the spell's level. On a success, you steal the spell and may cast it within 1 minute. Twice per long rest.

Arcane Trickster.name: Deepglass Trickster
Arcane Trickster.text: Your illusions work in total darkness and against blindsight and tremorsense. Creatures fooled by your illusions take an extra 3d8 psychic damage from your Sneak Attacks.

Arcane Trickster.name: Heartlock Trickster
Arcane Trickster.text: As an action, touch a creature and make a Sleight of Hand check against its Wisdom save. On a success, you learn one of its secrets and it is charmed by you for 1 hour. Once per short rest.

Arcane Trickster.name: Skyroad Illusionist
Arcane Trickster.text: Once per long rest, create an illusory landscape up to 1 mile across for 1 hour. Creatures inside make an Intelligence save or become lost, unable to find their way out.

Arcane Trickster.name: Nothing-Spell Trickster
Arcane Trickster.text: Three times per long rest, cast a spell of 5th level or lower without using a spell slot or components. Creatures cannot tell that you cast it.

Arcane Trickster.name: Unremembered Magician
Arcane Trickster.text: Creatures that see you cast a spell forget it immediately. Your spells cannot be counterspelled, and your illusions cannot be disbelieved by creatures that have forgotten you.

Arcane Trickster.name: First Trick Incarnate
Arcane Trickster.text: Once per long rest, make one illusion real for 1 minute. It can deal damage, block movement, and affect the world as if it were a true object or creature of challenge rating 20 or lower.

Assassin.name: Fogknife Assassin
Assassin.text: When you attack a creature from fog or dim light, the attack is a critical hit if it hits. You may then move up to 30 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

Assassin.name: Contract Assassin
Assassin.text: As an action, sign a contract on a creature. For 24 hours, your Sneak Attack against it deals an extra 3d6 damage and you always know its direction. Once per long rest.

Assassin.name: Chaos-Edge Assassin
Assassin.text: Your attacks cannot be predicted. Creatures cannot take reactions against your attacks, and once per turn you may roll Sneak Attack damage twice and use the higher result.

Assassin.name: Pitchblade Assassin
Assassin.text: When you hit an unaware creature in darkness, it makes a Constitution save. On a failure, it takes an extra 6d8 necrotic damage and is paralyzed until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

Assassin.name: Heartstop Assassin
Assassin.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a Constitution save or cannot regain hit points for 1 minute. You can tell how close any creature is to death by sight.

Assassin.name: Skyroad Killer
Assassin.text: Once per long rest, choose a creature you have seen within 1 mile. You teleport behind it and make an attack that is an automatic critical hit.

Assassin.name: Nothing-Blade Assassin
Assassin.text: Once per short rest, your attack ignores all resistances, immunities, and temporary hit points. If it reduces the target below 100 hit points, the target dies.

Assassin.name: Never-Was Killer
Assassin.text: When you kill a creature, every creature that saw it forgets you were there. Your attacks against creatures that have forgotten you deal an extra 5d8 damage.

Assassin.name: First Death Incarnate
Assassin.text: Once per long rest, make an attack against a creature. It makes a Constitution save. On a failure it dies outright. On a success it takes 20d10 necrotic damage.

Blood Dancer.name: Fogblood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: As a bonus action, spend 2d6 of your own hit points to exhale a 20-foot cloud of blood mist for 1 minute. You can see through it, and creatures inside have disadvantage on attacks against you.

Blood Dancer.name: Debtblood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: When you spend hit points to fuel a feature, your next Sneak Attack deals an extra 1d8 necrotic damage for each 5 hit points spent, up to 6d8.

Blood Dancer.name: Riotblood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: When you take damage, blood sprays from you, dealing 3d8 necrotic damage to a creature of your choice within 15 feet. If it is a fiend or undead, it is also blinded until the end of its next turn.

Blood Dancer.name: Deepblood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: As an action, choose a creature within 30 feet. It makes a Constitution save or its blood pressure spikes, dealing 5d8 necrotic damage and stunning it until the end of its next turn. Once per short rest.

Blood Dancer.name: Heartblood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: When you spend hit points, you gain the same amount as temporary hit points at the end of your next turn. You also gain resistance to necrotic damage.

Blood Dancer.name: Skyroad Bloodletter
Blood Dancer.text: Once per long rest, spill your blood across 120 feet for 1 minute. Enemies inside take 4d10 necrotic damage at the start of each turn, and you regain hit points equal to half of it.

Blood Dancer.name: Hollow-Vein Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: You no longer need blood. You can spend hit points without losing them twice per short rest, and creatures cannot drain your life force or hit point maximum.

Blood Dancer.name: Forgotten Blood Dancer
Blood Dancer.text: As an action, call back all the blood spilled within 60 feet in the past minute. You regain 8d10 hit points and enemies within range take 6d8 necrotic damage. Once per long rest.

Blood Dancer.name: First Blood Incarnate
Blood Dancer.text: Once per long rest, become the first blood for 1 minute. Your attacks drain 4d12 hit points from the target, and creatures within 60 feet make a Constitution save or bleed out at 0 hit points.

Inquisitive.name: Fogsight Inquisitor
Inquisitive.text: You automatically see through illusions and disguises within 30 feet. As a bonus action, make an Insight check against a creature's Deception; on a success, your next Sneak Attack against it deals an extra 2d8 damage.

Inquisitive.name: Twin Verdict Investigator
Inquisitive.text: As an action, ask a creature within 30 feet one question. It must answer truthfully unless it succeeds on a Charisma save, and if it lies you know it. Three times per long rest.

Inquisitive.name: Chaos-Mind Detective
Inquisitive.text: You cannot be surprised, and you have advantage on initiative rolls. Once per turn, when an enemy acts, you may predict its next action and gain advantage on your next attack against it.

Inquisitive.name: Deep-Truth Inquisitor
Inquisitive.text: You have truesight to 60 feet. Creatures that lie to you take 3d8 psychic damage and have disadvantage on their next save against your features.

Inquisitive.name: Heartsight Inquisitor
Inquisitive.text: As an action, learn a creature's deepest fear, desire, and weakness. Your attacks against it for 1 hour deal an extra 3d8 psychic damage. Once per long rest.

Inquisitive.name: Skyroad Investigator
Inquisitive.text: Once per long rest, learn the location of any creature or object you have seen, on any plane, and the path to reach it. You also learn whether it is guarded and by what kind of creatures.

Inquisitive.name: Nothing-Hides Inquisitor
Inquisitive.text: You cannot be deceived by any magic or mundane means. Once per short rest, after observing a creature for 1 round, you know all its abilities and weaknesses.

Inquisitive.name: Remembering Inquisitor
Inquisitive.text: As an action, recover any memory that has been erased or forgotten within 60 feet. Creatures whose memories you recover are freed from charm and confusion. Three times per long rest.

Inquisitive.name: First Truth Incarnate
Inquisitive.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute no creature within 300 feet can lie, become invisible, or disguise itself. Your attacks against them deal an extra 4d12 psychic damage.

Mastermind.name: Fogveil Mastermind
Mastermind.text: As a bonus action, whisper a plan to an ally within 60 feet. Until the end of its next turn, it is invisible to enemies and has advantage on its next attack, which deals an extra 2d8 damage.

Mastermind.name: Contract Mastermind
Mastermind.text: Once per long rest, make a deal with a creature. If it agrees, it must fulfil its side within 24 hours or take 6d10 psychic damage and become charmed by you.

Mastermind.name: Loaded-Hand Mastermind
Mastermind.text: As a reaction when an enemy within 60 feet rolls a d20, you may force a reroll and choose which result it uses. Three times per long rest.

Mastermind.name: Deep-Plot Mastermind
Mastermind.text: Enemies within 60 feet have disadvantage on saves against your features. Allies within 60 feet may use your Help action as a reaction once per round.

Mastermind.name: Heartstring Mastermind
Mastermind.text: As an action, choose a creature within 30 feet. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 1 minute and follows your commands. Once per short rest.

Mastermind.name: Skyroad Mastermind
Mastermind.text: Once per long rest, set a plan into motion: up to six allies anywhere on the same plane gain an extra action on their next turn and advantage on all rolls for 1 minute.

Mastermind.name: Nothing-Plot Mastermind
Mastermind.text: Creatures cannot tell that you are behind any of your schemes. Allies you help with the Help action gain +1 AC until your next turn.

Mastermind.name: Never-Was Mastermind
Mastermind.text: As an action, rewrite a creature's plans. It makes a Wisdom save or forgets its current goal and takes 5d8 psychic damage. Three times per long rest.

Mastermind.name: First Schemer Incarnate
Mastermind.text: Once per long rest, rewind the last round. All creatures return to where they were at the start of it, but you and your allies keep the knowledge of what happened.

Nightblade.name: Fogshadow Blade
Nightblade.text: As a bonus action, teleport from one area of dim light, darkness, or fog to another within 60 feet. Your next Sneak Attack this turn deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage.

Nightblade.name: Hellshade Blade
Nightblade.text: When you teleport, you leave a burst of hellfire shadow behind. Creatures within 10 feet of your starting point make a Dexterity save or take 3d8 fire damage.

Nightblade.name: Chaos Shadowblade
Nightblade.text: When you teleport, you may teleport up to two allies within 10 feet of you to spaces near your destination. Each gains advantage on its next attack.

Nightblade.name: Pitchdepth Blade
Nightblade.text: You can teleport through any darkness within 120 feet. Creatures in darkness take an extra 3d8 necrotic damage from your Sneak Attack. You also see normally in magical darkness out to 120 feet.

Nightblade.name: Heartshadow Blade
Nightblade.text: Your shadow becomes a companion that can make one attack each turn, dealing 3d8 necrotic damage. It shares your hit points and moves with you.

Nightblade.name: Starless Shadowblade
Nightblade.text: Once per long rest, teleport to any point you can see within 1 mile. Your first attack after arriving deals an extra 6d10 necrotic damage.

Nightblade.name: Nothing-Shadow Blade
Nightblade.text: While in darkness, you cannot be targeted by attacks or spells unless the attacker succeeds on a Wisdom save. Your Sneak Attack ignores necrotic resistance.

Nightblade.name: Unremembered Shade
Nightblade.text: When you teleport, creatures that saw you before make a Wisdom save or forget you existed. Your attacks against them are critical hits. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to this for 24 hours.

Nightblade.name: First Night Incarnate
Nightblade.text: Once per long rest, become the first night for 1 minute. You can teleport anywhere within 300 feet as a bonus action, and your attacks deal an extra 5d12 necrotic damage.

Phantom.name: Fogghost Phantom
Phantom.text: When a creature dies within 30 feet of you, its spirit lingers in the fog. You may consult it as an action to learn one fact it knew, or deal 3d8 necrotic damage to a creature within 30 feet.

Phantom.name: Hell-Shade Phantom
Phantom.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you may deal an extra 3d6 necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 feet. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Phantom.name: Riot-Shade Phantom
Phantom.text: As a bonus action, become incorporeal until the start of your next turn. You can move through creatures and objects and have resistance to all damage.

Phantom.name: Drowned-Soul Phantom
Phantom.text: Creatures within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on saves against necrotic damage. When they take necrotic damage, they also take 3d8 cold damage. You gain resistance to cold and necrotic damage.

Phantom.name: Heartghost Phantom
Phantom.text: When a creature dies within 30 feet, you may capture its soul. Spend a captured soul to regain 4d10 hit points or deal an extra 4d10 necrotic damage on a hit.

Phantom.name: Skyroad Phantom
Phantom.text: Once per long rest, become a spirit for 1 hour. You can fly at 120 feet, pass through objects, and cannot be harmed except by force or radiant damage.

Phantom.name: Nothing-Ghost Phantom
Phantom.text: When you become incorporeal, you are also invisible. Creatures you pass through take 4d8 necrotic damage and are frightened until the end of their next turn.

Phantom.name: Never-Was Phantom
Phantom.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or its spirit forgets its body. It is incapacitated for 1 minute and takes 6d8 necrotic damage. Twice per long rest.

Phantom.name: First Ghost Incarnate
Phantom.text: Once per long rest, become the first ghost for 1 minute. You are immune to all damage except radiant, and your attacks deal an extra 5d12 necrotic damage.

Scout.name: Fogtrail Scout
Scout.text: You ignore difficult terrain and fog. Once per turn, after you hit, you may move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks and become invisible until the start of your next turn.

Scout.name: Brimstone Outrider
Scout.text: Your speed increases by 20 feet. When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you may make one attack against it as a reaction and deal an extra 2d8 fire damage.

Scout.name: Chaos-Path Scout
Scout.text: As a bonus action, teleport up to 30 feet. Once per turn, if you teleport before attacking, your attack has advantage and deals an extra 2d8 force damage.

Scout.name: Deep-Path Scout
Scout.text: You can breathe underwater and see in darkness to 120 feet. Your Sneak Attack deals an extra 3d8 damage against creatures in difficult terrain. You also gain a climbing and swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

Scout.name: Heartwild Scout
Scout.text: You cannot be slowed, grappled, or restrained. Allies within 30 feet of you gain an extra 10 feet of speed and can move through difficult terrain without penalty.

Scout.name: Starfield Scout
Scout.text: You can see clearly up to 10 miles. Once per long rest, you and up to six allies can travel 100 miles in one hour without being noticed.

Scout.name: Hollow-Path Scout
Scout.text: Your movement makes no sound and leaves no trace. Once per short rest, take an extra turn immediately after your current one. During that extra turn, you cannot cast a spell of 6th level or higher.

Scout.name: Never-Was Scout
Scout.text: Creatures cannot track you by any means. As an action, erase the trail of up to six allies for 24 hours. Your first attack each combat deals an extra 5d8 damage.

Scout.name: First Scout Incarnate
Scout.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you take two turns each round, act first in initiative, and cannot be targeted by reactions. Your speed also doubles and you cannot be slowed or surprised.

Shade Walker.name: Fogshade Walker
Shade Walker.text: You can move through dim light and fog without being seen. When you start your turn in dim light, you may teleport up to 60 feet to another area of dim light.

Shade Walker.name: Brimshade Walker
Shade Walker.text: Your Sneak Attack deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage when you attack from darkness. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you gain 3d10 temporary hit points.

Shade Walker.name: Chaos-Shade Walker
Shade Walker.text: As a bonus action, swap places with any creature standing in dim light within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of its next turn.

Shade Walker.name: Pitch-Shade Walker
Shade Walker.text: You can see in magical darkness and walk on walls and ceilings of shadow. Your attacks from darkness score critical hits on 19-20. You also cannot be blinded while in darkness.

Shade Walker.name: Heartshade Walker
Shade Walker.text: You can merge with an ally's shadow as an action, moving with them and attacking from their space. While merged, you have resistance to all damage.

Shade Walker.name: Starshade Walker
Shade Walker.text: Once per long rest, step into your shadow and out of any shadow on the same plane that you have seen. You may bring up to two willing creatures within 5 feet of you along with you.

Shade Walker.name: Nothing-Shade Walker
Shade Walker.text: You cannot be tracked, scried, or detected by divination magic. Your attacks against a creature that cannot see you deal an extra 4d8 necrotic damage.

Shade Walker.name: Unremembered Walker
Shade Walker.text: Creatures that lose sight of you make a Wisdom save or forget you exist for 1 minute. You may move through them freely. Your attacks against them have advantage.

Shade Walker.name: First Shade Incarnate
Shade Walker.text: Once per long rest, become the first shadow for 1 minute. You cannot be seen or targeted except by area effects, and your attacks deal an extra 5d12 necrotic damage.

Soul Thief.name: Fogsoul Thief
Soul Thief.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you may steal a memory from the target. It forgets one skill proficiency for 1 minute, and you gain that proficiency for the same duration.

Soul Thief.name: Brimsoul Thief
Soul Thief.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you steal 2d8 of the target's life force, regaining that many hit points. Fiends and celestials take an extra 2d8 necrotic damage.

Soul Thief.name: Riotsoul Thief
Soul Thief.text: When a creature within 30 feet rolls a 20 on a d20, you may steal it as a reaction, forcing a reroll and banking the 20 to use for your own next d20. Twice per long rest.

Soul Thief.name: Deepsoul Thief
Soul Thief.text: When you hit a creature, it makes a Charisma save or loses 3d8 maximum hit points until it finishes a long rest. You gain the same amount as temporary hit points.

Soul Thief.name: Heartsoul Thief
Soul Thief.text: As an action, touch a creature and steal one of its class or racial features for 1 hour. It makes a Charisma save to resist. Once per long rest.

Soul Thief.name: Skyroad Soulthief
Soul Thief.text: Once per long rest, steal a creature's location. You swap places with any creature you can see within 1 mile, and it makes a Charisma save or is stunned for 1 round.

Soul Thief.name: Nothing-Soul Thief
Soul Thief.text: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you capture its soul. While you hold a soul, you gain resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. You may hold up to three souls.

Soul Thief.name: Never-Was Soulthief
Soul Thief.text: As an action, steal a creature's identity for 1 hour. It makes a Charisma save or forgets who it is, and you can perfectly impersonate it. Twice per long rest.

Soul Thief.name: First Soul Incarnate
Soul Thief.text: Once per long rest, steal a creature's soul. It makes a Charisma save or dies, and you gain its hit points as temporary hit points. On a success, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage.

Soulknife.name: Mistedge Soulknife
Soulknife.text: Your psychic blades can be thrown through fog and illusions without penalty. When you hit with a psychic blade, the target makes an Intelligence save or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

Soulknife.name: Brimmind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: Your psychic blades deal an extra 2d6 psychic damage. When a blade hits a fiend or celestial, the target has disadvantage on its next save.

Soulknife.name: Chaos-Edge Soulknife
Soulknife.text: As a bonus action, manifest four psychic blades that orbit you for 1 minute. As a reaction when you take damage, launch one, dealing 3d8 psychic damage to the attacker. Once per short rest.

Soulknife.name: Deepmind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: Your psychic blades ignore resistance to psychic damage. When you hit an unaware creature, it is stunned until the end of its next turn on a failed Intelligence save.

Soulknife.name: Heartmind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: You gain resistance to psychic damage. Once per turn, when you hit with a psychic blade, you may regain 3d8 hit points. Allies within 30 feet also gain resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence saves.

Soulknife.name: Starmind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: Once per long rest, launch psychic blades at every creature you can see within 300 feet. Each takes 6d10 psychic damage on a failed Intelligence save, half on a success.

Soulknife.name: Hollowmind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: Your psychic blades cannot be perceived. They ignore all resistances and immunities, and creatures they hit cannot take reactions until your next turn. Once per turn, a blade hit deals an extra 3d8 psychic damage.

Soulknife.name: Forgotten-Mind Soulknife
Soulknife.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes an Intelligence save or forgets how to cast spells and use features for 1 minute. Three times per long rest.

Soulknife.name: First Mind Incarnate
Soulknife.text: Once per long rest, become the first mind for 1 minute. Your psychic blades deal an extra 5d12 psychic damage, and creatures you hit make an Intelligence save or are paralyzed.

Swashbuckler.name: Fogdance Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.text: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may use your reaction to step into fog and strike back, making a weapon attack that deals an extra 2d8 damage.

Swashbuckler.name: Brimstone Duelist
Swashbuckler.text: As a bonus action, challenge a creature within 30 feet. For 1 minute, its attacks against anyone but you have disadvantage, and your attacks against it deal an extra 2d8 fire damage.

Swashbuckler.name: Wild Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.text: When you hit a creature, choose a random trick: disarm, trip, or blind. It makes a Dexterity save or suffers that effect until the end of its next turn.

Swashbuckler.name: Deep-Current Duelist
Swashbuckler.text: You gain +1 AC. When a creature misses you, its next attack against you has disadvantage and you deal an extra 3d8 damage to it.

Swashbuckler.name: Heartstrike Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.text: When you charm a creature, it is charmed for 1 hour. While charmed, it defends you, and you have advantage on Charisma checks against all creatures within 60 feet.

Swashbuckler.name: Skyroad Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.text: Once per long rest, challenge a creature to a duel. For 1 minute, you and it are moved to a pocket plane, and you deal an extra 5d10 damage to it.

Swashbuckler.name: Nothing-Blade Duelist
Swashbuckler.text: Once per short rest, when you are hit, the attack instead misses and you make an attack against the attacker that is an automatic critical hit.

Swashbuckler.name: Never-Was Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.text: When you duel a creature, all other creatures forget the duel. It makes a Wisdom save or forgets its own allies and fights only you. Three times per long rest.

Swashbuckler.name: First Duelist Incarnate
Swashbuckler.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you make three extra attacks each turn, cannot be hit by attacks of opportunity, and every hit forces a Dexterity save or the target drops prone.

Thief.name: Fogfinger Thief
Thief.text: As a bonus action, steal an object from a creature within 30 feet without being seen. It makes a Wisdom save to notice. You can also use magic items without meeting their requirements.

Thief.name: Brimstone Thief
Thief.text: You can steal from devils and angels alike. When you steal a magic item, you may use its properties immediately, and you are immune to curses on stolen items.

Thief.name: Loaded-Hand Thief
Thief.text: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet rolls a d20, you may steal its luck, forcing it to reroll and giving you advantage on your next roll. Three times per long rest.

Thief.name: Pitch-Hand Thief
Thief.text: You can steal in total darkness with no penalty. Creatures you steal from in darkness make a Wisdom save or forget they owned the item.

Thief.name: Heartfinger Thief
Thief.text: As an action, steal a spell, memory, or skill from a creature within 5 feet. It makes a Charisma save or loses it for 1 hour, and you gain it. Once per short rest.

Thief.name: Skyroad Thief
Thief.text: Once per long rest, steal an object you can see within 1 mile. It appears in your hands, and the owner does not notice for 1 hour.

Thief.name: Nothing-Finger Thief
Thief.text: You can steal intangible things: a creature's shadow, voice, or reflection. Without them, it has disadvantage on related checks. Three times per long rest. The theft lasts 1 hour, or until you return the stolen thing.

Thief.name: Never-Was Thief
Thief.text: When you steal, the owner forgets the item ever existed. Once per long rest, you can steal a creature's memory of you completely. The creature makes a Wisdom save to resist this second effect.

Thief.name: First Theft Incarnate
Thief.text: Once per long rest, steal a power from a creature of challenge rating 25 or lower. It loses one feature, spell, or action for 1 minute, and you gain it.
